$comment: Baseline version for untagged builds — local development, branches, pull requests. A tagged GitHub release overrides this: tools/version/resolve.ts reads the tag and derives both the npm version (1.2.3) and the four-part Office manifest version (1.2.3.0, last component always zero). Bump this when starting work on the next version; the release itself comes from the tag. Do not edit versions in package.json or manifest.xml by hand.
